name: GetCustomerPriorityDetails
description: Reads the FULL Priority customer record (all ~150 columns of RAW.PRIORITY_1_CUSTOMERS in Brain, via query_table, read-only) for one customer, for the customer card's details and finance tabs. No write anywhere; the Customers mirror is untouched.

record.description: Every column of the customer's row, keyed by the UPPER-case Priority column name; null when not found

error.description: Set when Brain could not be read

usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Opening a customer card tab**: Clicking the "פרטי לקוח" or "פיננסי" tab on a customer's card
  Reads the customer's full, current record from Priority (identity, address, contacts, agent, payment terms, credit and insurance, bank) so everything is shown in organised cards.
